answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fakes. Each agent claims one work slot by burning a $30 deposit, never refunded, in a registry solid as basalt. A comet cannot reuse a burned slot, and a nebula of 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 burns. Attacking costs 1,000 x $30 = $30,000 against a $3,000 pool, a $27,000 loss. An honest agent burns $30 once, keeps its full share, and renews the slot with verified work, so honesty is cheap and fakes stay expensive.
